instruction.text: Write the largest and the smallest possible numbers that round to the given number.
An unknown number has been rounded to the nearest thousand and the result was 97,000. Write the largest and smallest possible numbers that would round to this number.
An unknown number has been rounded to the nearest ten thousand and the result was 40,000. Write the largest and smallest possible numbers that would round to this number.
An unknown number has been rounded to the nearest hundred thousand and the result was 667,300,000. Write the largest and smallest possible numbers that would round to this number.
An unknown number has been rounded to the nearest million and the result was 56,000,000. Write the largest and smallest possible numbers that would round to this number.
